name: bag-submission
description: Turn a prompt, skill, or workflow a clinician built into a finished Bag Submission post for The AI Clinicians' Medical Bag community library. Interviews them one field at a time, enforces the three rules the bag runs on (returns a draft not a final artifact, bans invention, ends with a real verify), keeps every entry patient-data-free, tests it on a synthetic case, and hands back a paste-ready post.
